title: Zang International with Lynette Zang: Dollar Resets and Nixon’s Landslide: Lynette Zang’s
description:
Original video author: Zang International with Lynette Zang. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. Dollar resets do not automatically spell political defeat, argues Zang International with Lynette Zang, citing Nixon’s 520-electoral-vote reelection. We recap her account of Roosevelt’s 1933–34 changes, distinguishing gold devaluation from grocery inflation, then cover the 1971–73 break with gold and move to floating exchange rates. Next are her arguments about inflation, monetary authority, public confidence and physical ownership. Zang favors gold and silver, including pre-1933 coins; her company sells these metals.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
